'''Ranroon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was particularly known for its legendary [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Hylei Indrexu Cortess|Indrexu]].

==Description==
Ranroon was a planet of dizzying peaks and clifftop aeries. It was a matriarchal world where ancient traditions were proudly held and outsiders regarded with deep suspicion.<ref name="Xim Week" />

==History==
Ranroon was attacked by [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] during the expansion of his [[Xim's empire|empire]] circa [[25,100 BBY]]. The planet was the site of a fierce [[Battle of Ranroon|battle]] where the forces of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Hylei Indrexu Cortess]] resisted bravely against Xim's janissaries. They were eventually defeated but the queen's resistance made her a legendary figure, equal to Xim himself.<ref name="Xim Week" />

The planet was absorbed into the sixth province of Xim's empire, the [[Far Indrexu]], named in honor of the Queen of Ranroon.<ref name="Xim Week" /> Xim's treasure [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Queen of Ranroon/Legends|''Queen of Ranroon'']], was also named after her.<ref name="HSR">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref> Since that time, Ranroon inhabitants retained some of the feel of the rancorous against the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].<ref name="Xim Week" />
